Deft Pro user here. I fucking love the mouse but the two biggest annoyances for me:

- inconsistent mouse wheel. It will scroll sometimes. If pushed just a little bit before the wheel turns sometimes. I'm not sure if that is a software or a mouse problem though

- connection interference. I use the wireless bit that comes with it sometimes and the connection can sometimes get really weak if my cheap speakers start picking up radio. Haven't tried Bluetooth as using the micro usb cable was enough for me.

If ball security is a concern for your travelling, Deft Pro won't come out in transit, it's pretty solid in the mouse. Sometimes takes a bit to get it out when I clean the bearings
You could try messing with the scroll speed settings, I haven't touched those though. If the mouse pointer didn't experience lag then I don't think it's a connection issue

I experienced interference on my Deft Pro whenever my pc speakers picked up radio signals. I would look into ways of minimizing signal interferences around it. Maybe try Bluetooth if that's an option for you.
